About Crosby

Crosby is built on a simple conviction: a great legal system is the watermark of a great society — and the best legal work comes from combining human expertise with the right technology, not replacing one with the other.

Crosby is the first AI-native law firm, helping ambitious companies like Cursor, Ramp, and Cognition sign commercial contracts faster.

Legal work is both art and science, and we're mapping the frontier between the two — codifying what can be systematized, amplifying human judgment where it matters most. That's why the right way to bring AI into law isn't to sell software and walk away. It's to own the outcome together: higher-quality work, delivered faster. We build proprietary tools and human-in-the-loop workflows that change what's possible for corporate legal teams.

Crosby was founded by Ryan (Stanford Law, Cooley, startup GC) and John (Penn, first 15 engineers at Ramp). Help us transform one of society's most important industries.

Job Duties: Crosby Legal, Inc. in New York, NY is seeking Senior Commercial Counsel to represent clients in legal proceedings, draw up legal documents, or manage or advise clients on legal transactions. Individual(s) will apply advanced-level, theoretical knowledge of Business Regulations, Litigation, and Arbitration law, as well as a deep understanding of complex commercial agreements for technology and/ or software clients.

Job responsibilities and duties include:

1. Contract Negotiation: Lead negotiations of Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), Nondisclosure Agreements (NDAs), and software licensing agreements for technology clients.

2. Deal Structuring: Advise clients on risk allocation, liability, indemnity, data protection, and intellectual property ownership.

3.Client Advisory: Serve as outside general counsel for scaling startups, providing guidance on commercial, regulatory, and data privacy matters.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the client’s sales, product, and/or engineering teams to accelerate deal closure while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation.

5. Process Improvement: Develop and refine internal playbooks, fallback positions, and negotiation frameworks to ensure quality and consistency across client work.

6. Knowledge Management: Contribute to Crosby’s Legal Memory System—an internal platform for capturing and reusing institutional knowledge to enhance efficiency and quality of legal work.

7. Mentorship and Training: Support junior counsel and Contract Managers by reviewing work product, providing feedback, and leading internal workshops on negotiation strategy and legal reasoning.

This position does not supervise any personnel or participate in any management decisions, nor does this position plan, direct or coordinate the activities of any personnel.

Minimum requirements: Master’s degree in Laws or higher from an accredited law school plus two (2) years of experience in any related position(s) in which the required experience was gained.

  • License: Require active bar license in at least one US state with good standing.

Qualified applicants must also have demonstrable proficiency, skill, experience, and knowledge with the following:

  1. SaaS, software licensing, and data protection frameworks (including GDPR and CCPA).

  2. Require 2-yrs of exp. drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts, including non-disclosure agreements, master services agreements, data processing agreements, order forms, and statements of work.

  3. Require 2-yrs of exp. serving as legal counsel, from either law firm or in-house experience, working with three or more products, business lines, or stakeholders simultaneously.

No travel. Work from home is allowed anywhere within the US.

Additional Information:

· Job Site: 166 Crosby Street PH, New York, NY 10012. Salary $185,000/yr

· Benefits: Employer offers standard medical, dental, 401K, and long-term disability benefits.

· Submit resumes to: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/crosby

· EOE/Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship

Equal Opportunity

Crosby is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the New York City Fair Chance Act.

Pursuant to New York Labor Law Section 194-b, the US Pay Range for this position is listed in the job post. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.
